# Shell script tests

Goldens of the [completion scripts](shells.temper.md) for each shell,
so a change to one shows in review. The scripts run in real shells in
`tests/shells/run.py`, which completes command lines through them.

## bash

    test("bash script") {
      let cli = new Command({ name: "frob" });
      assert(cli.completionScript(Shell.bash) == """
        "# bash completion for frob, generated by Argmas.
        "#
        "# Save this as ~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions/frob for the
        "# bash-completion package to load when needed, or source it from
        "# ~/.bashrc. Needs bash 4.4 or later.
        "
        "_frob_argmas() {
        "    local line=\${COMP_LINE:0:COMP_POINT} words=() word= quote= open=0 started= keep=0 c j
        "    # bash completes only the part of a word after its last = or :.
        "    local breaks=\${COMP_WORDBREAKS//[^=:]/}
        "    # The words as the program gets them, without their quotes and
        "    # backslashes, noting where in the last bash replaces what's typed:
        "    # after an open quote, or else after its last = or : outside quotes.
        "    for (( j = 0; j < \${#line}; j++ )); do
        "        c=\${line:j:1}
        "        if [[ $quote == "'" ]]; then
        "            if [[ $c == "'" ]]; then quote=; else word+=$c; fi
        "        elif [[ $quote == '"' ]]; then
        "            if [[ $c == '"' ]]; then
        "                quote=
        "            elif [[ $c == '\\' && \${line:j+1:1} == [\\"\\\\\\$\\`] ]]; then
        "                word+=\${line:j+1:1}
        "                (( j++ ))
        "            else
        "                word+=$c
        "            fi
        "        elif [[ $c == [[:space:]] ]]; then
        "            [[ -n $started ]] && words+=("$word")
        "            word= started= keep=0
        "        else
        "            started=1
        "            if [[ $c == [\\"\\'] ]]; then
        "                quote=$c open=\${#word}
        "            elif [[ $c == '\\' ]]; then
        "                word+=\${line:j+1:1}
        "                (( j++ ))
        "            else
        "                word+=$c
        "                [[ -n $breaks && $c == ["$breaks"] ]] && keep=\${#word}
        "            fi
        "        fi
        "    done
        "    words+=("$word")
        "    [[ -n $quote ]] && keep=$open
        "    local cur=$word program=\${words[0]} kept=\${word:0:keep}
        "    [[ $program == "~/"* ]] && program=$HOME/\${program:2}
        "    local out lines=() files=() found=() i quoted
        "    out=$("$program" __complete $(( \${#words[@]} - 2 )) "\${words[@]:1}" 2>/dev/null) || return 0
        "    mapfile -t lines <<< "$out"
        "    local directive=\${lines[\${#lines[@]}-1]}
        "    unset 'lines[\${#lines[@]}-1]'
        "    for i in "\${lines[@]}"; do
        "        i=\${i%%$'\\t'*}
        "        [[ -n $i && $i == "$kept"* ]] && found+=("\${i:keep}")
        "    done
        "    case $directive in
        "    :files*|:directories*)
        "        local prefix= option=-f
        "        [[ $directive == *" "* ]] && prefix=\${directive#* }
        "        [[ $directive == :directories* ]] && option=-d
        "        if [[ -z $prefix && \${#found[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
        "            if [[ $option == -f ]]; then compopt -o default; else compopt -o dirnames; fi
        "            return 0
        "        fi
        "        compopt -o filenames
        "        mapfile -t files < <(compgen "$option" -- "\${cur#"$prefix"}")
        "        for i in "\${files[@]}"; do
        "            i=$prefix$i
        "            [[ $i == "$kept"* ]] && found+=("\${i:keep}")
        "        done
        "        ;;
        "    esac
        "    # bash quotes what it inserts, closing an open quote, when told the
        "    # candidates are file names, as files are; others need that only in
        "    # a quote or when the shell would read some character in them.
        "    for i in "\${found[@]}"; do
        "        printf -v quoted %q "$i"
        "        if [[ -n $quote || $quoted != "$i" ]]; then
        "            compopt -o filenames
        "            break
        "        fi
        "    done
        "    COMPREPLY=("\${found[@]}")
        "    return 0
        "}
        "
        "complete -F _frob_argmas 'frob'
      );
    }

## zsh

    test("zsh script") {
      let cli = new Command({ name: "frob" });
      assert(cli.completionScript(Shell.zsh) == """
        "#compdef frob
        "# zsh completion for frob, generated by Argmas.
        "#
        "# Save this as _frob in a directory on $fpath, such as ~/.zfunc with
        "# fpath=(~/.zfunc $fpath) before compinit in ~/.zshrc, or source it
        "# after compinit.
        "
        "_frob_argmas() {
        "    local -a lines described
        "    local line directive prefix program=\${(Q)words[1]}
        "    program=\${program/#\\~/$HOME}
        "    lines=("\${(@f)$("$program" __complete $(( CURRENT - 2 )) "\${(@Q)words[2,CURRENT-1]}" "\${(Q)PREFIX}" 2>/dev/null)}")
        "    (( \${#lines} )) || return 1
        "    directive=\${lines[-1]}
        "    lines[-1]=()
        "    for line in $lines; do
        "        [[ -n $line ]] || continue
        "        if [[ $line == *$'\\t'* ]]; then
        "            described+=("\${\${line%%$'\\t'*}//:/\\\\:}:\${line#*$'\\t'}")
        "        else
        "            described+=("\${line//:/\\\\:}")
        "        fi
        "    done
        "    local ret=1
        "    (( \${#described} )) && _describe -t values 'frob' described && ret=0
        "    case $directive in
        "    :files*|:directories*)
        "        [[ $directive == *' '* ]] && compset -P "\${(b)directive#* }"
        "        if [[ $directive == :files* ]]; then
        "            _files && ret=0
        "        else
        "            _files -/ && ret=0
        "        fi
        "        ;;
        "    esac
        "    return ret
        "}
        "
        "if [[ $zsh_eval_context[-1] == loadautofunc ]]; then
        "    _frob_argmas "$@"
        "else
        "    compdef _frob_argmas 'frob'
        "fi
      );
    }

## fish

    test("fish script") {
      let cli = new Command({ name: "frob" });
      assert(cli.completionScript(Shell.fish) == """
        "# fish completion for frob, generated by Argmas.
        "#
        "# Save this as ~/.config/fish/completions/frob.fish.
        "
        "function __frob_argmas
        "    set -l words (commandline -opc)
        "    set -l current (commandline -ct)
        "    # The word being completed as the program gets it, without its
        "    # quotes and backslashes, as the other words already are; an open
        "    # quote is closed first.
        "    set -l unquoted
        "    for closing in '' '"' "'"
        "        if set unquoted (string unescape -- "$current$closing" 2>/dev/null)
        "            set current "$unquoted"
        "            break
        "        end
        "    end
        "    set -l arguments $words
        "    set -e arguments[1]
        "    set -l lines ($words[1] __complete (count $arguments) $arguments $current 2>/dev/null)
        "    or return
        "    set -q lines[1]
        "    or return
        "    set -l directive $lines[-1]
        "    set -e lines[-1]
        "    for line in $lines
        "        test -n "$line"
        "        and echo $line
        "    end
        "    set -l prefix (string replace -r '^:\\S+ ?' '' -- $directive)
        "    set -l path (string sub -s (math (string length -- "$prefix") + 1) -- "$current")
        "    switch $directive
        "        case ':files*'
        "            for p in (__fish_complete_path "$path")
        "                echo $prefix$p
        "            end
        "        case ':directories*'
        "            for p in (__fish_complete_directories "$path")
        "                echo $prefix$p
        "            end
        "    end
        "end
        "
        "complete -c 'frob' -f -a '(__frob_argmas)'
      );
    }

## PowerShell

    test("powershell script") {
      let cli = new Command({ name: "frob" });
      assert(cli.completionScript(Shell.powershell) == """
        "# PowerShell completion for frob, generated by Argmas.
        "#
        "# Add this to your profile (the file $PROFILE names), or save it and
        "# dot-source it from there, but not as frob.ps1 in a directory on
        "# PATH, where PowerShell would run it in place of frob. Needs
        "# PowerShell 5.1 or later.
        "
        "Register-ArgumentCompleter -Native -CommandName @('frob', 'frob.exe') -ScriptBlock {
        "    param($wordToComplete, $commandAst, $cursorPosition)
        "    $words = @()
        "    foreach ($element in $commandAst.CommandElements) {
        "        $extent = $element.Extent
        "        if ($extent.StartOffset -ge $cursorPosition) { break }
        "        $text = $extent.Text
        "        if ($extent.EndOffset -gt $cursorPosition) {
        "            $text = $text.Substring(0, $cursorPosition - $extent.StartOffset)
        "        } elseif ($element -is [System.Management.Automation.Language.StringConstantExpressionAst]) {
        "            $text = $element.Value
        "        }
        "        $words += $text
        "    }
        "    $arguments = @($words | Select-Object -Skip 1)
        "    $index = $arguments.Count
        "    if ($wordToComplete -ne '') { $index -= 1 }
        "    $lines = @(& $words[0] __complete $index @arguments 2>$null)
        "    if ($lines.Count -eq 0) { return }
        "    $directive = $lines[-1]
        "    $results = @()
        "    foreach ($line in ($lines | Select-Object -SkipLast 1)) {
        "        if ($line -eq '') { continue }
        "        $value, $description = $line -split "`t", 2
        "        if (-not $description) { $description = $value }
        "        $text = $value
        "        if ($value -match '[\\s''"`$;,(){}|&<>@#]') { $text = "'" + ($value -replace "'", "''") + "'" }
        "        $results += [System.Management.Automation.CompletionResult]::new($text, $value, 'ParameterValue', $description)
        "    }
        "    if ($directive -match '^:(files|directories)(?: (.*))?$') {
        "        $kind = $Matches[1]
        "        $prefix = "$($Matches[2])"
        "        # With nothing else to offer, PowerShell completes files itself,
        "        # but directories only here.
        "        if ($kind -eq 'files' -and $prefix -eq '' -and $results.Count -eq 0) { return }
        "        $part = $wordToComplete.Substring([Math]::Min($prefix.Length, $wordToComplete.Length))
        "        foreach ($path in [System.Management.Automation.CompletionCompleters]::CompleteFilename($part)) {
        "            if ($kind -eq 'directories' -and $path.ResultType -ne 'ProviderContainer') { continue }
        "            $results += [System.Management.Automation.CompletionResult]::new($prefix + $path.CompletionText, $path.ListItemText, $path.ResultType, $path.ToolTip)
        "        }
        "    }
        "    $results
        "}
      );
    }

## Names

A function's name keeps ASCII letters and digits of the program's
name, with `_` for anything else, and the name is quoted for each
shell, so an odd name can't break a script.

    test("names in scripts") {
      let cli = new Command({ name: "my-tool's" });
      let bash = cli.completionScript(Shell.bash);
      assert(contains(bash, "_my_tool_s_argmas() {"));
      assert(contains(bash, "complete -F _my_tool_s_argmas 'my-tool'\\''s'\n"));
      assert(contains(cli.completionScript(Shell.zsh), "compdef _my_tool_s_argmas 'my-tool'\\''s'\n"));
      assert(contains(cli.completionScript(Shell.fish), "complete -c 'my-tool\\'s' -f -a '(__my_tool_s_argmas)'\n"));
      assert(contains(cli.completionScript(Shell.powershell), "-CommandName @('my-tool''s', 'my-tool''s.exe')"));
    }

A subcommand's script is its top command's, and `Shell.named` takes
the names `--completions` does.

    test("shells by name") {
      let git = new Command({ name: "minigit" });
      let add = git.subcommand({ name: "add" });
      assert(add.completionScript(Shell.fish) == git.completionScript(Shell.fish));
      assert(Shell.named("bash") == Shell.bash);
      assert(Shell.named("powershell") == Shell.powershell);
      assert(Shell.named("cmd") == null);
      assert(Shell.named("Bash") == null);
    }
